stack: npm workspaces monorepo; Vite 6 + React 19 SPAs (apps/grid, apps/axle), Tailwind CSS 4, lucide-react 0.546, motion 12, recharts 3 (grid only), Supabase (auth, Postgres with RLS, edge functions ai-proxy / axle-admin / signup-org), packages/shared (types, entitlements, design-tokens.css); Cloudflare Pages

surfaces.responsive: md (768px): sidebar becomes a slide-over drawer opened by a 44px Menu button in the top bar, closed by backdrop tap or choosing an item. sm (640px): clock and breadcrumb hidden. lg (1024px): facility in breadcrumb, product name in brand pill and 'MOCK DATA' label shown. xl (1280px): search shown. Desktop-first pages (Site Layout, Warehouse Floor, Operations Flow, Simulation) show a Monitor icon in the mobile nav and an amber advisory banner. No bottom tab bar. KPI grids on Analytics do not reflow on phones (fixed grid-cols-4).
surfaces.active_state: Active item: bg --navy-light #F1ECFF, text and icon --navy #2C09B2, 1px border --navy-mid #CBB6FA, icon stroke 2.5; inactive text --text-2, icon --text-3, hover bg --bg-hover. Locked: text-3 at 70% opacity. No aria-current on staff nav buttons.

colours.status: green #1A7A4A, amber #B8720A, red #C0392B, blue #1A5FB4 (not the shared core set)

surfaces.fonts: Poppins (UI) and JetBrains Mono (labels, eyebrows, clock), loaded from Google Fonts in index.html; group labels mono 9px uppercase tracking 0.14em; nav labels 13px medium
surfaces.a11y: Header round buttons are 44px with focus-visible ring 2px --navy (violet, not AntaraX blue #0459F7). Nav buttons have no visible focus style beyond browser default and no aria-current. .input-field removes the outline (index.css:81) and uses a navy box-shadow. No prefers-reduced-motion handling anywhere (motion/react page transitions, popovers, pulsing dots). Muted text tokens tuned to WCAG AA.
surfaces.role_variants: Staff nav is identical for every staff role (superadmin, admin, operations_manager, supervisor, operator, customs_officer, viewer); role limits are applied per action inside pages (roleDenied tooltips). Plan tier changes the nav only by adding lock icons. Role tenant_portal gets a completely separate shell (TenantPortalShell). In org mode the role comes from org_members.role; in demo mode from the selected profile.

brand_gaps: No 'PLExyz Grid · by AntaraX' credit anywhere in the chrome, sign-in or AXLE; the user guide cover reads 'PLExyz Grid by REKA' (12, 09).

Uppercase eyebrow with an em dash still ships: 'PLEXYZ GRID — WAREHOUSE INTELLIGENCE' (apps/grid/src/components/Auth/LoginPage.tsx:42) and 'PLEXYZ GRID AXLE — PLATFORM ADMIN' (apps/axle/src/components/Auth/AdminLoginPage.tsx:37); sidebar eyebrow 'WAREHOUSE INTELLIGENCE' is mono uppercase, not an intan eyebrow in violet.

Logo and wordmark still use the original zone colours (#CBB6FA, #4FD7D1, #FD9001, #FD4F85), not the approved AntaraX versions (#B9B8F5, #0CC4FB, #F47B3D, #E9579D); the same old values are the --zone-* tokens.
Status colours are app-specific (#1A7A4A, #B8720A, #C0392B) rather than the shared core (#12B76A, #F79009, #F04438); Tailwind green/blue/gray are used for the allocation bar.

Focus ring is violet --navy and only on header buttons; inputs remove the outline (apps/grid/src/index.css:81, apps/axle/src/index.css:58); 13 §10 asks for a visible AntaraX-blue #0459F7 ring everywhere.
No prefers-reduced-motion handling in either app (motion/react transitions, pulsing dots).
No Help item or /help route; guide is a modal, not /guide (13 §8).

AXLE is named 'PLExyz Grid AXLE — Platform Admin', light and violet with the Grid mark; 13 §6 asks for 'AXLE · PLExyz Grid', dark ground #071233, REKA orange #FB9800 and the AntaraX A, at axle.antarax.ai.

Words: 'Organization'/'organization' (US spelling) on sign-in, AXLE and upgrade copy; 'workspace' also used for the account; 'Sign Out' in title case; roles shown as Superadmin/Admin/Operations Manager etc. (13 §1).
Plans shown as free/trial/standard/advanced/intelligent (AXLE tier select, UpgradeRequired) instead of Seed, Nova, Galaxy, Quantum with descriptors (13 §3).
Money written 'RM 656,379.00' and 'RM 139,227' with a space; 13 §3 wants 'RM656,379.00'. Dates shown as US locale '9/2/2026' and '10/14/2026, 3:00:00 AM' in AXLE.
'Contact your REKA account manager/team' on sign-in and the upgrade screen instead of the support line support@go.antarax.ai.
Tenant Portal shell carries no PLExyz Grid or AntaraX branding at all (only the tenant's code tile).
No app tile or manifest; AI entry points use the Sparkles icon but are not the AntaraX AI sparkle, and the optimiser panel uses a text glyph '✦'.

The top-bordered stat card rule (07) is now only dead CSS: .kpi-card with border-top-width 3px is defined (apps/grid/src/index.css:418) but no component uses it; Analytics KPI cards use coloured values instead.
notes: Grid has no dedicated dashboard: the home is the Warehouse Floor canvas with a floating 'Live Operations Stats' window; the KPI-and-chart page is Analytics (Occupancy & Utilisation, Facility Breakdown, Cargo & Dwell Time, Movements & Operations, Revenue & Commercial, Incidents & Compliance; recharts horizontal bars and a donut; over-time charts are 'No history recorded yet' placeholders; date-range chips and exports are disabled). Neither app has URL routing; pages are React state, so routes above are activePage values. AXLE's landing page is the Organizations table. Customer captures used the repo's own no-backend demo mode; sign-in, pending approval, free-plan and all AXLE captures used a dummy Supabase URL with Playwright page.route stubs and fictional data; no real backend was contacted. Live pages (grid.antarax.ai, plexyz-grid-axle.pages.dev) could not be reached through the sandbox proxy.
